note: City of New Hampton campground next to Mikkelson Park and across the street from the pool, run by New Hampton's Boy Scout troops. Hookup sites 1-23 plus grass tent spaces. --Claude
summary: Confirmed water/sewer, 26 spots with pull-throughs, showers, dump, FCFS. Base raised $10 -> $18 (the $10 is tent-only grass sites with no service). Season May 1-Oct 31 added from the city page; rally-week closure added to booking.note. Note cleaned. Not waterfront stands. Pin OK.
flags: FEES: stored low $10 was the tent rate ('Tents: (Grass sites with no service) One night - $10.00'); the camper base is $18 (sites 1-23 with water, sewer, electric). The page's rates carry no date beyond the 2026 page footer (city entry, no 2024+ gate).

PHONE MISSING: none stored. City of New Hampton Parks & Recreation, 641-394-5464 (https://www.newhamptonia.com/contact-parks-recreation); the campground page itself lists City Hall 641-394-5906 (641-394-2070 is the fax). apply.py doesn't write phone.
RALLY WEEK: 'All campsites are reserved for New Hampton Motorcycle Rally Patrons ONLY from Labor Day until the following Sunday in September!' Recorded in booking.note.
LONG STAY: a $400 monthly rate is posted beside the $18 nightly and $125 weekly; ordinary city campground, nightly sold first come, so no long-stay concern.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands; no water near (in town beside ballfields).

PIN: NAIP shows RVs on a gravel lot and grass sites at ~43.0578,-92.3028, about 70 m west of the stored pin 43.05797,-92.30192, which sits on the grass beside the ballfield. Under the 250 m threshold, no move needed. Electric amperage not posted. No Google listing found for the campground itself (Mikkelson Park 4.7 / 318).
